en: A block and tackle with four pulleys provides a mechanical advantage of four, allowing a 400-newton load to be lifted with only 100 newtons of effort.
Ice has a low friction coefficient of about 0.03, allowing a hockey puck sliding at 10 meters per second to glide over 50 meters before stopping.
The Moon's gravity is one-sixth of Earth's, so a person weighing 600 newtons on Earth would weigh only 100 newtons on the lunar surface.
The Earth's magnetic north pole is currently in the Arctic Ocean, about 400 kilometers from the geographic North Pole, and moves roughly 50 kilometers yearly.
A typical lightning bolt carries about 300 million volts, which is over 1.3 million times stronger than the 230 volts in a standard Philippine wall outlet.
Light travels at 300,000 kilometers per second, meaning it takes approximately 1.3 seconds for sunlight reflected off the Moon to reach an observer on Earth.
Sound travels through air at 343 meters per second, but it moves over four times faster through water at approximately 1,480 meters per second.
Water requires about five times more heat energy to warm up than an equal mass of dry sand, which is why beaches cool quickly at night.
A 1,000-kilogram roller coaster car at a 50-meter height has 490,000 joules of potential energy, which converts to kinetic energy as it drops to the bottom.
One gram of fat contains about 9 kilocalories of chemical energy, which is more than double the 4 kilocalories found in one gram of carbohydrates.
A wood screw with 10 threads per centimeter has a 1-millimeter pitch, meaning it moves forward exactly 1 millimeter into the wood per full turn.
A belly-down skydiver reaches a terminal velocity of 54 meters per second, but diving head-first reduces air resistance to increase speed to over 80 meters per second.
